data.name: Alisa
data.gender_notes: Alisa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἀλεξία (Alexia), which means 'defender' or 'helper'. In Christian tradition, Alisa is considered a form of Alexandra and is associated with the Virgin Mary and Saint Alexis. The name Alisa carries the meaning “Noble, kind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alisa usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of kindness, protection, and aid.
data.etymology: Alisa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alisa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אליסה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליסה הוא נגזר מהמילה העברית 'אלישוע' או 'אלישע', שפירושה 'אלוהים הוא ישועתי' או 'אלוהים ישועתי'. השם אליסה הוא צורה נגזרת של השם אלישוע, ששימש ככינוי לאלישע, הנביא המקראי. השם אליסה משמש גם כסמלה לנוכחות אלוהית בחיי אדם.

in_greek.name: Αλίσα
in_greek.meaning: Αλίσα - σημαίνει Θεός η σωτηρία μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλίσα είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Ελισάβετ ή Ελισά, που προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα 'אלישוע' (Elisheva) ή 'אלישע' (Elishe'a), που σημαίνει 'Θεός η σωτηρία μου' ή 'Θεός είναι η σωτηρία'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ελισάβετ αναφέρεται στη μητέρα του Ιωάννη του Βαπτιστή.

in_latin.name: Alisa
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alisa derivatur ex hebraeo nomine 'אלישוע' (Elisheva) vel 'אלישע' (Elishe'a), quod significat 'Deus est salus mea' vel 'Deus est salvator meus'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Alisa seu Elisabet erat usitatum inter christianos, qui filias suas sic nominabant in signum devotionis ad Deum.

in_english.name: Alisa
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alisa originates from the Hebrew name 'אלישוע' (Elisheva) or 'אלישע' (Elishe'a), meaning 'God is my salvation' or 'God saves'. In Christian tradition, Alisa is associated with Saint Elisabeth, mother of John the Baptist. The name symbolizes divine protection and salvation.

data.cultural_impact: Alisa is a Slavic variant of the Greek name Alexia, which has been popularized among Christian communities in Eastern Europe, especially Russia. With its association to the biblical Aaron and Greek warrior-goddess Alexia, Alisa carries a noble and powerful connotation- a woman who embodies strength, resistance, and protection.
data.spiritual_significance: To Christians, Alisa represents the embodiment of the virtues of defense and help. As a name inspired by the Mother of God and Saint Alexis, Alisa is a reminder of the role of the Divine Providence in our daily lives and the importance of offering support and defense to others. The name Alisa is also linked to the spiritual ideals of perseverance and fortitude, inspiring those who bear it to be defenders of faith and assistants to those in need.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Alisa in Hebrew means "noble, exalted" or "God's oath". It is a variation of the name Elisabeth, which means "God's promise". The name Alisa signifies the strength and honor of one who trusts in God's promises and upholds a noble character.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Alisa was a popular name among the Russian nobility during the 15th and 16th centuries. The name Alisa carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Alisa is a common name in Russia and other Eastern European countries
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Alisa remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Alisa from New York, United States embodies the meaning of Alisa - "Noble, kind". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
